verdict.rationale: CIPO runs account-based services (MyCIPO Patents, online trademark filing), so exporting a user's own data is a fair question. The evidence only shows public bulk-data downloads and patent-record downloads, which are registry datasets rather than a user exporting their own account data. Nothing documents an account-level export or the formats used, so the bulk data is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
